universal_patterns.pattern: any holder of a license[^.]*under this Act

proposal.rationale: Illinois compiles its occupational licensing statutes under Chapter 225 ILCS (Professions, Occupations, and Business Operations), where each individual practice act is identified by a numeric "Act" token in the citation "225 ILCS NNN/..." (e.g., 225 ILCS 60/ for the Medical Practice Act). Unlike Utah/Florida, Illinois does not have a single umbrella chapter that applies across all practice acts; each Act is self-contained. Citation patterns therefore capture the Act number (e.g., "60", "65") as the chapter token in the slug. Universal patterns are kept narrow—only "this Act applies to any/every/all" and "any holder of a license under this Act"—because the broader "as used in this Act" phrase is automatically handled by the cross-state AS_USED_RE walker. Trigger phrases follow the standard "licensed under/to practice/pursuant to" forms used to enumerate practice-act references. No range_chapter_pattern or profession_name_trigger_patterns are needed for IL.
